entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 30392773430255360: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.2540 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 121.15 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -18.839, -98.379 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.00145 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4511 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). Mass 0.903 (0.863 to 0.943) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source). Temperature 5418.77 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4511 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,418.77 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecde. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,418.77 K and log g 4.39 (u1 0.541, u2 0.206): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
